name: How long does stucco repair take?
description: Repair time varies from a single day for minor issues to several days or weeks for extensive damage, including drying and curing times.

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco repair depends primarily on the size and severity of the damaged area. Small, cosmetic repairs like hairline cracks might be completed in a single day. More extensive repairs involving water damage, substrate replacement, or large sections of crumbling stucco could take several days to a week or more. The curing time for new stucco also adds to the overall timeline, as it requires adequate drying before being subjected to weather elements. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after inspecting the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a single day for minor issues to several days or weeks for extensive damage, including drying and curing times.
